  "description": "Domeo Resources International (DRI) is a prolific organisation which proffers HR and Management Consultancy solutions premised on excellence and innovation. DRI analyses various organisational problems, develops improvement plans, deploys those plans and monitors the plans to ensure improved organisational performance.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Account Payable &amp; Account Receivable Officer

Job Location: Abia
Reports to: Chief&nbsp;&nbsp;Accountant / Financial Controller
Supervises: None
Department: Finance &amp; Accounts

Job Summary


	The Accounts Payable / Accounts Receivable Officer is responsible for managing the hotel&#39;s accounts payable and accounts receivable functions to ensure timely processing of supplier payments, efficient collection of customer receivables, accurate financial record-keeping, and effective cash flow management.
	The role ensures that all financial transactions are properly authorized, accurately recorded, and comply with the hotel&#39;s financial policies, accounting standards, and statutory requirements.
	The position works closely with Procurement, Cost Control, Front Office, Food &amp; Beverage, Conference &amp; Banquet, Sales &amp; Marketing, Stores, Human Resources, and other operational departments to maintain accurate financial records, strengthen internal controls, and support the hotel&#39;s financial performance.


Key Responsibilities
Accounts Payable Management:


	Process supplier invoices accurately and promptly.
	Verify that all invoices are supported by approved Purchase Requisitions (PRs), Purchase Orders (POs), Goods Received Notes (GRNs), supplier invoices, and other supporting documentation before payment.
	Match supplier invoices with purchase orders and goods received documentation.
	Prepare payment vouchers for approval.
	Schedule supplier payments in accordance with agreed payment terms.
	Maintain accurate supplier account records and payment history.
	Reconcile supplier statements and resolve discrepancies promptly.
	Monitor outstanding supplier balances and payment obligations.
	Respond to supplier enquiries professionally and promptly.


Accounts Receivable Management:


	Raise invoices for corporate clients, conferences, banquets, accommodation, events, restaurants, and other hotel services.
	Monitor customer accounts and outstanding receivables.
	Follow up on overdue accounts through reminders, calls, emails, and client visits where necessary.
	Process receipts and allocate payments accurately.
	Reconcile customer accounts regularly.
	Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies.
	Monitor credit limits and ensure compliance with approved credit policies.
	Prepare aging analysis reports and recommend collection strategies.


Billing &amp; Revenue Support:


	Ensure accurate billing for all hotel services.
	Verify room charges, conference charges, food and beverage invoices, laundry services, transportation, spa, and other guest services before invoicing.
	Coordinate with Front Office, Conference &amp; Banquet, Sales, and Food &amp; Beverage Departments to resolve billing issues.
	Ensure timely issuance of invoices and statements of account.
	Support accurate revenue recognition in accordance with accounting standards.


Cash Flow &amp; Financial Management:


	Monitor daily cash inflows and outflows relating to payables and receivables.
	Support cash flow planning through timely collections and payment scheduling.
	Assist in forecasting cash requirements.
	Ensure efficient management of working capital.
	Report significant outstanding balances to the Chief Accountant.


Reconciliation &amp; Financial Records:


	Perform daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliation of supplier and customer accounts.
	Reconcile accounts receivable and accounts payable ledgers with the general ledger.
	Assist in bank reconciliation where required.
	Maintain complete and accurate accounting records.
	Investigate and resolve reconciliation differences promptly.


Credit Control:


	Monitor customer credit accounts.
	Ensure customers operate within approved credit limits.
	Recommend suspension of credit facilities where necessary.
	Follow up on overdue debts and implement approved collection procedures.
	Prepare reports on delinquent accounts for Management review.
	Support legal recovery processes where authorized.


Internal Controls &amp; Compliance:


	Ensure compliance with financial policies and approval procedures.
	Verify completeness of supporting documentation before processing transactions.
	Maintain segregation of duties within payable and receivable processes.
	Prevent duplicate payments and fraudulent transactions.
	Safeguard confidential financial information.
	Support internal control improvements.


Audit Support:


	Prepare schedules and documentation required during internal and external audits.
	Provide supporting documents for audit reviews.
	Respond promptly to audit queries.
	Assist in implementing audit recommendations relating to payables and receivables.
	Maintain audit-ready financial records.


Tax &amp; Statutory Compliance:


	Ensure applicable withholding tax (WHT), VAT, and other statutory deductions are correctly applied to supplier payments.
	Maintain proper tax documentation.
	Assist in preparing tax schedules and statutory reports.
	Support compliance with tax regulations and reporting requirements.


Reporting &amp; Documentation:


	Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable reports.
	Prepare supplier aging reports.
	Prepare customer aging reports.
	Monitor collection performance and payment trends.
	Maintain accurate financial files and electronic records.
	Submit reports within established reporting deadlines.


Collaboration &amp; Stakeholder Management:


	Work closely with Procurement on supplier account management.
	Coordinate with Sales &amp; Marketing regarding corporate client billing.
	Liaise with Front Office on guest account reconciliation.
	Work with Conference &amp; Banquet teams on event billing.
	Coordinate with Cost Control regarding inventory-related invoices.
	Maintain positive relationships with suppliers and customers.


Compliance &amp; Continuous Improvement:


	Comply with company policies, accounting standards, and financial procedures.
	Participate in training and professional development programmes.
	Recommend process improvements that strengthen efficiency and internal controls.
	Support automation initiatives within the Finance Department.
	Promote continuous improvement in financial operations.


Requirements
Education:


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or Higher National Diploma (HND) in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.


Experience :


	Minimum of 3&ndash;5 years of experience in Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Finance, or Accounting.
	Experience in a hotel, hospitality organization, or service industry is highly desirable.
	Working knowledge of hotel accounting systems such as IDS Next, Opera PMS, SunSystems, Sage, SAP, or similar ERP systems is an added advantage.


Professional Certifications (Preferred):


	ACA (ICAN).
	ACCA.
	ATS (Accounting Technicians Scheme).
	CITN (added advantage).
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software.


Skills &amp; Competencies:


	Accounts Payable Management.
	Accounts Receivable Management.
	Credit Control.
	Invoice Processing.
	Financial Reconciliation.
	Financial Reporting.
	Cash Flow Management.
	Tax Compliance.
	Microsoft Excel (Advanced).
	Accounting Software.
	Data Analysis.
	Communication and Negotiation Skills.
	Attention to Detail.
	Time Management.
	Problem Solving.
	Integrity and Confidentiality.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Cover Letters to: recruitment@domeoresources.org using &quot;Account Payable &amp; Account Receivable Officer_Aba&quot; as the subject of the email.

  "description": "The Borough Lagos - Nestled in the heart of Lagos, our boutique hotel offers unparalleled luxury and service. Whether you&rsquo;re in Lagos working, relocating or traveling with your family, our boutique hotel will delight you with plush amenities with upscale d&eacute;cor. The Borough Lagos is already the trusted choice for the world&rsquo;s leading corporations, international organizations, and discerning private clients who want to relax in the stylish comfort and feel of their own home while on a long or short stay in the Lagos area.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Executive Assistant (Hospitality &amp; Retail)

Job Location: Lekki Phase 1, Lagos, Nigeria
Job Type: Full time

Job Brief


	We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and resourceful Executive Assistant to provide comprehensive administrative and operational support to the CEO across multiple businesses, including a retail and caf&eacute; business, a boutique hotel and restaurant, and other business ventures.
	This role requires an individual who can manage competing priorities, maintain strict confidentiality, anticipate the needs of a busy executive, and ensure the smooth coordination of daily business and personal commitments.
	The ideal candidate is an experienced Executive Assistant who has supported senior executives or business owners with multiple entities and is comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
	The successful candidate must possess exceptional organizational skills, sound judgment, excellent communication abilities, and the discretion required to handle sensitive information.


Responsibilities


	Manage the CEO&#39;s calendar, appointments, meetings, and daily schedule across multiple businesses.
	Coordinate internal and external meetings, prepare agendas, record meeting minutes, and follow up on action items.
	Prioritize incoming requests, correspondence, and communications, ensuring urgent matters receive immediate attention.
	Screen phone calls, emails, and other communications on behalf of the CEO.
	Draft, proofread, and prepare professional emails, reports, presentations, letters, and other business documents.
	Coordinate travel arrangements, accommodation, transportation, and detailed itineraries for business trips.
	Act as the primary point of contact between the CEO and internal teams, clients, vendors, business partners, and other stakeholders.
	Monitor ongoing projects across the CEO&#39;s businesses and follow up with department heads to ensure timely execution of tasks and deadlines.
	Assist in tracking business priorities, ensuring deliverables are completed as scheduled.
	Coordinate cross-functional activities between the retail, hospitality, and other business operations.
	Organize executive meetings, management meetings, and strategic planning sessions.
	Maintain accurate records, confidential files, contracts, and important business documents.
	Prepare reports, dashboards, and summaries to support executive decision-making.
	Conduct research, gather information, and prepare briefing materials for meetings and business opportunities.
	Assist with special projects, new business initiatives, and operational improvements as assigned.
	Manage office administration tasks relating to the Executive Office.
	Handle confidential and sensitive business information with the highest level of professionalism and discretion.
	Build and maintain positive working relationships with clients, suppliers, government agencies, consultants, and external stakeholders.
	Anticipate the CEO&#39;s needs and proactively resolve issues before they arise.
	Support occasional personal administrative tasks for the CEO where required.
	Perform any other duties assigned by the CEO.

Customer Experience Manager Job at SixthLab Medical




        
    

        
        SixthLab Medical (also appearing as Sixth?Lab?Ventures) is a Nigeria-based company specialising in the supply and servicing of diagnostic and therapeutic medical equipment and consumables.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Customer Experience Manager

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The Customer Experience Manager is responsible for overseeing and improving the end-to-end customer experience at Sixthlab Medical Nigeria Limited.
	The role ensures customers receive exceptional service from initial enquiry through product delivery, installation, after-sales support, and ongoing relationship management.
	The successful candidate will coordinate closely with the Sales, Biomedical Engineering, Logistics, Procurement, Finance, and HR teams to ensure timely service delivery, effective complaint resolution, customer retention, and continuous improvement of the customer journey.
	The role will also drive the effective use of Zoho CRM to ensure customer information, service activities, and follow-ups are accurately captured and managed.


Key Responsibilities
Customer Experience & Relationship Management:


	Manage and continuously improve the entire customer journey across all touchpoints.
	Develop and implement initiatives to improve customer satisfaction, loyalty, and retention.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and stakeholders.
	Conduct regular customer follow-ups and satisfaction surveys.


Customer Service Operations:


	Ensure prompt and professional handling of customer enquiries, requests, and complaints.
	Establish service standards and monitor adherence to agreed response and resolution timelines.
	Coordinate customer onboarding, product orientation, and after-sales support activities.
	Ensure customers receive timely updates on deliveries, installations, preventive maintenance, and service requests.


Complaint Resolution:


	Manage customer complaints through to resolution while ensuring excellent customer communication.
	Coordinate with relevant departments to resolve issues promptly.
	Identify recurring customer concerns and recommend process improvements to prevent recurrence.


Cross-Functional Coordination:


	Work closely with Sales, Technical, Logistics, Procurement, and Finance teams to ensure seamless service delivery.
	Monitor outstanding customer issues and drive timely resolution.
	Support effective communication between internal teams and customers.


CRM & Reporting:


	Manage the effective use of Zoho CRM for customer records, interactions, service requests, and follow-ups.
	Ensure customer information is accurate, complete, and up to date.
	Prepare weekly and monthly customer experience reports, highlighting trends, customer feedback, complaints, and improvement opportunities.


Team Leadership:


	Supervise Customer Service personnel and provide coaching where required.
	Develop customer service procedures and standard operating processes.
	Promote a customer-first culture across the organization.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
	Customer Retention Rate
	Complaint Resolution Time
	First Response Time to Customer Enquiries
	Customer Complaint Closure Rate
	CRM Data Accuracy and Compliance
	Customer Follow-up Completion Rate
	Service Delivery Turnaround Time
	Number of Customer Experience Improvement Initiatives Implemented


Qualifications & Experience

Education:


	Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Customer Service, Healthcare Administration, or a related discipline.


Experience:


	Minimum of 4–6 years' experience in Customer Service, Customer Experience, Customer Success, or Operations Management.
	At least 2 years in a supervisory or managerial role.
	Experience in the medical, healthcare, diagnostics, pharmaceutical, or related industry is an added advantage


Salary
N200,000 - N250,000 monthly.
